game.title: Forza Horizon 6
game.blurb: Open-world racing set in Japan, released 2026-05-19. RAWG has no average playtime yet. Genre: Racing. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Opening Act
chapters.summary: Arrive in Japan, join the Horizon Festival and learn the basics.

chapters.title: Festival Wristbands
chapters.summary: Climb the wristband tiers from Yellow through Gold by entering Festival events.

chapters.summary: Discover regions, landmarks, activities and the Collection Journal stamps.

chapters.title: Cars and Garage
chapters.summary: Buy, find and show off cars, and set up the Yashiki player house.

chapters.title: Mastery and Completion
chapters.summary: Long-term goals: full map, mascots, race wins, Horizon Play levels.
